# Scholas USA — Partnership Proposal for the Carrie Estelle Doheny Foundation

> A Catholic-inspired partnership proposal from Scholas USA: strengthening faith,
> empowering young people, and transforming communities in Los Angeles.

Scholas USA is a Catholic-inspired educational movement founded by Pope Francis.
Working alongside the Archdiocese of Los Angeles, it creates spaces of encounter
where young people discover belonging, deepen their connection to faith,
strengthen family relationships, and become leaders of service in their
communities.

## What this site presents

- The Scholas mission and its parish-based model, rooted at St. Thomas the
  Apostle in Pico-Union, Los Angeles.
- A five-step accompaniment pathway: safe spaces, relationships, leadership,
  family strengthening, and service.
- Program targets for the Pico-Union initiative (300 young people, 50 families)
  — proposed targets, not completed outcomes.
- Proposed philanthropic partnership levels for discussion with the Carrie
  Estelle Doheny Foundation.
- A verified statement from Archbishop José H. Gómez of Los Angeles and links
  to Angelus News coverage of Scholas USA.
